<div class="page-section page-section--info c-info js-animate-loading js-hidden" id="what-is-photo-mechanic-1">
<h2 class="page-section__title page-section__title--red">What is Photo Mechanic?</h2>
<h3 class="page-section__subtitle">Use Photo Mechanic<sup><span style="font-size:10px;">®</span></sup> 6 to view, organize, manage, and export digital photos</h3>
<div class="page-section__content page-section__content--cols2">
<div class="story story--basic page-section__col">
<p>The minute you put down the camera, your post-processing workflow begins. The most productive photographers in the world use Photo Mechanic’s powerful features to make managing photos faster and easier.  Quickly ingest photos from your memory cards and pick your winners without having to wait.</p>
</div>
<div class="story story--basic page-section__col">
<p>Use tools originally created for photographers under the world’s most extreme deadlines to add information such as captions, keywords, and copyright to your images as fast as possible. Finally, deliver those images to the world with powerful export features. Photo Mechanic speeds up your workflow, and you take all the credit. </p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="page-section page-section--benefits c-benefits js-animate-loading js-hidden" id="benefits-of-photo-mechanic-6--2">
<h2 class="page-section__title decorated-headline c-benefits__title">Benefits of Photo Mechanic 6:</h2>
<ul class="c-benefits__list">
<li class="c-benefits__single c-benefits__single--icon" data-number="1">
<figure class="c-benefits__icon">
<img src="https://home.camerabits.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/icon-v6-lg-clientdelivery.png"/>
</figure>
<h4 class="tertiary-headline c-benefits__subtitle">Fast Viewing / Culling</h4>
<div class="story story--basic c-benefits__descr"><p>Go from your memory card to working on your best images faster than ever before. Ingest, cull, rate, and organize for a quicker, more efficient workflow.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="c-benefits__single c-benefits__single--icon" data-number="2">
<figure class="c-benefits__icon">
<img src="https://home.camerabits.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/copy_and_batch-2.png"/>
</figure>
<h4 class="tertiary-headline c-benefits__subtitle">Work How You Want</h4>
<div class="story story--basic c-benefits__descr"><p>Let's work together. Photo Mechanic is built to play nice with your other post-processing and creative tools so that you're in control.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="c-benefits__single c-benefits__single--icon" data-number="3">
<figure class="c-benefits__icon">
<img src="https://home.camerabits.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/icon-v6-lg-settings.png"/>
</figure>
<h4 class="tertiary-headline c-benefits__subtitle">Captions, Keywords, and Copyright</h4>
<div class="story story--basic c-benefits__descr"><p>A picture is worth a thousand words, but only the embedded metadata counts. Get your images tagged faster with crucial info like credit and copyright to protect your business. </p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
